title.es: Aquel en el que se enfrentan a Tasio
title.en: The One Where They Confront Tasio

description.es: Fina visita a Claudia en la tienda y esta le confiesa que quisiera contarle a Carmen sobre la contratación de Paula. Tasio aparece y ambas lo enfrentan, reclamándole por sus acciones. Marta le cuenta a Cloe que tienen dos días para vender La Industrial y poder contra ofertar a Floral, Cloe decide ayudarla y le propone un posible comprador. Cloe sueña despierta con darle un beso a Marta.
description.en: Fina visits Claudia at the store, and Claudia confesses that she would like to tell Carmen about Paula's hiring. Tasio shows up and the two of them confront him, calling him out for his actions. Marta tells Cloe that they have two days to sell La Industrial in order to make a counteroffer to Floral; Cloe decides to help her and suggests a possible buyer. Cloe daydreams about giving Marta a kiss.
